sourceScope: Standalone current ERP source: seven operational JAKH addons, required dependency profile, security/audit/migration helpers, tests, deployment definitions and bilingual demo guide.
notPublished: API keys, tokens and invitation links
githubHistoryPolicy: Preserve the existing initial README commit; append reviewed source without force-push or history deletion. Review the staged publication tree separately from history.
localInstallationPolicy: Keep the original running preview and private data recoverable until destination state and recovery are verified. No deletion or uninstall performed.
portabilityChange: Native staging defaults to repository-local work/ for a standalone checkout, while the legacy outputs layout preserves its original work directory. Existing private runtime metadata/binaries are not portable state.
nativeEngineeringBaseline: 193 native tests per synthetic market: exact r5 Saudi runtime and maintained-source UAE fixture, with retained-demo recovery proof. Historical evidence paths are not included local files or new-host acceptance.

handoverSourceChecks.publicationSafety: 270 candidate source files; no errors, one preserved upstream README historical-path warning; no credential content printed
handoverSourceChecks.existingHistoryReview: One initial commit containing only the repository-title README; inspected before appending source

remainingGates: Select authorized encrypted hosting/storage and residency per customer
Snapshot and transfer matched databases plus filestores through a private channel
Build/run the exact container and validate restored-state enrollment without bypass
Reconcile roles, attachments, posted balances and retained demo workflows
Verify independent backup/recovery and owner access on the destination
Approve production identity, TLS, localization, security and customer acceptance
Authorize traffic cutover and only then decide original-machine retirement
